To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Morocco's economic growth and employment prospects are good, but that to achieve high-income status and significantly reduce unemployment, Morocco will need, over the medium term, to implement far-reaching reforms to increase growth to about 7 percent and create employment at a rate of about 35, 000 jobs per percentage of growth.

Morocco can achieve high income status in the medium run if it implements a growth model that involves, among other things, promoting the transition of its economy from labor intensive imitation to technology intensive innovation, improving the quality and relevance of its educational system, improving productivity in key sectors, and promoting gender equality in the labor force.
